dying-well.title: All-Party Parliamentary Group on Dying Well
dying-well.purpose: To promote excellence in palliative care for all to meet their needs and prevent the legalisation of doctor assisted suicide and euthanasia.

choice-at-the-end-of-life.title: All-Party Parliamentary Group for Choice at the End of Life
choice-at-the-end-of-life.purpose: To improve the experience of dying in the UK by promoting and expanding people's choices at the end of life. To promote a change in the law to allow the choice of assisted dying for terminally ill, mentally competent adults.

hospice-and-end-of-life-care.title: All-Party Parliamentary Group on Hospice and End of Life Care
hospice-and-end-of-life-care.purpose: To raise awareness and promote the needs of adults and children living with terminal or life-limiting conditions, and their families and carers, in parliament; and to promote person-centred, evidence-based policies to improve end of life care in all settings, including hospices, hospitals, care homes, and in people's own homes.

pro-life.title: All-Party Parliamentary Pro-Life Group
pro-life.purpose: To provide a forum for discussion of pro-life issues including abortion, euthanasia and research upon the human embryo.

humanist.title: All-Party Parliamentary Humanist Group
humanist.purpose: To bring together non-religious MPs and peers to discuss matters of shared interests.

christians-in-parliament.title: Christians in Parliament All-Party Parliamentary Group
christians-in-parliament.purpose: To support Christians of all denominations and parties in their work in politics.
